newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cabletron Systems a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cabletron Systems a buy.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co said analyst Paul Johnson reiterated a buy rating on shares of Cabletron Systems Inc, based on his belief that "the market for next-generation backbone networking technologies is poised to accelerate during the second half of 1997."
Cabletron shares were up two points to 45 at mid-afternoon.

In a statement, Johnson said Cabletron is one of the best-positioned companies in the computer networking arena. He said Cabletron's "Synthesis network architecture...will extend the company's leadership in the high-end market for switching hubs."
